        ### Question
        A 78-year-old male has been hospitalized for the past 3 days after undergoing a revision left total hip replacement. Which of the following is most likely true of this patient's current condition?

        ### Options

opb. Beta-amyloid plaques and neurofibrillary tangles are pathologic findings associated with this condition
opc. Short-term memory is often impaired, with sparing of remote memory

ope. Possible etiologies include infection, trauma, or polypharmacy
